description: This file defines the 'Smarty_Internal_CacheResource_File' class, which is part of the Smarty templating engine. The class manages caching of templates on the file system, including populating cache metadata, reading, writing, clearing cache files, and managing lock states for cache files.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_CacheResource_File
classes.description: Manages file system caching for Smarty templates, including cache population, reading, writing, clearing, and lock management.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates a cached object with metadata, including file path and timestamp, based on the resource.

methods.name: populateTimestamp
methods.description: Populates the cached object's timestamp and existence status from the file system.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Reads and processes the cached template content, optionally updating if necessary.

methods.name: writeCachedContent
methods.description: Writes rendered content to cache and updates cache metadata; invalidates opcache or APC caches if supported.

methods.name: readCachedContent
methods.description: Reads cached template content from the file system.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears all cache files managed by the cache resource.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears cache for a specific resource, cache ID, and compile ID.

methods.name: hasLock
methods.description: Checks if the cache for a template is locked.

methods.name: acquireLock
methods.description: Creates a lock file to lock cache for a template.

methods.name: releaseLock
methods.description: Removes the lock file to unlock cache for a template.
